warnings.value: Genital mycotic infections and urinary tract infections are more common due to glucose in the urine. Volume depletion/hypotension can occur, especially with diuretics.

lessons.title: Why GI upset happens
lessons.body: Metformin commonly causes GI effects early on. Educational counselling: take with food, escalate if severe — Materia does not publish titration numbers here.

lessons.title: Kidneys and contrast
lessons.body: Renal function and iodinated contrast procedures matter for metformin safety conversations. Confirm against current SA guidance and the labelled product.
